{{Top|leg}}
The '''Garden Circle''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. The various circles on Kegan formed an interconnected ring around the [[Gathering Circle]] at the city's center. The Garden Circle was connected to the [[Study Circle]] on one side. The Circle contained winding paths, leafy and blooming [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] [[Tree/Legends|trees]], forested areas, [[bramble]]s, and [[Grass/Legends|grass]]. Despite having fresh fruit growing in the Garden Circle, only dried fruit could be found on sale in the market.<ref name="TFFT">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref>
